# Octopus Deploy

Welcome to the Octopus Deploy Trust Center! We are committed to providing you with world class standards of security & data privacy for all your deployment and continuous delivery needs.

You can explore our [frequently asked questions](https://trust.octopus.com/faq) Opens in new tab, request access to comprehensive security documentation, and gain a clear understanding of how we [safeguard your data](https://trust.octopus.com/resources) Opens in new tab.

Additionally, we invite you to subscribe for updates to stay informed about the latest advancements in our security and compliance initiatives, just click the bell in the upper right corner of this screen to do so.

### eMudhra CA Compromise: Octopus & Codefresh not affected

Published November 9, 2026

We have seen no indications that Octopus deploy and its services have been impacted by the CA compromise. Any virtual machine, container or tooling images that did trust eMudhra's compromised CAs have been updated to patched versions which are no longer impacted, well within our committed timelines for reacting to vulnerable dependencies. You can read more about these commitments at [https://advisories.octopus.com/severity-levels/](https://advisories.octopus.com/severity-levels/) Opens in new tab

Stay safe out there!

Security

### PHP2Shell: Octopus and Codefresh not affected

Published October 23, 2026

Customers should be aware of two recently disclosed vulnerabilities in PHP, CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619, commonly known as [PHP2Shell](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/PHP2Shell) Opens in new tab.

### Octopus

Octopus makes minimal use of PHP, and we don’t use it to build our products. The octopus.com website isn’t built on PHP or on technologies that depend on it.

Octopus Server, Octopus Cloud, Tentacle, and their dependencies are built on the Microsoft .NET runtime.

Our assessment found no configuration or use of PHP in Octopus Server or our web-facing assets.

### Codefresh

The same applies to the Codefresh product. The codefresh.com website assets (which are all low risk, static content) are hosted on WordPress, and our hosting provider has patched these systems for PHP2Shell.

Before the patch was released, we put proactive mitigations in place at the network and server layers. Our log analysis shows no indication of successful exploitation.

If you have any questions, please contact us at [support@octopus.com](mailto:support@octopus.com).

Compliance

### Update to Octopus Deploy's Subprocessors

Published July 27, 2026

In your Data Processing Agreement (DPA) with Octopus Deploy, we commit to notifying you before any new third-party sub-processor starts processing applicable data. We’re sending this message because we’re planning to appoint a new third-party sub-processor. No action is required from you.

The new third-party sub-processor is Hex (hex.tech).

Hex is a collaborative analytics platform combining SQL, Python, and AI in a single workspace. We will use it to query data, build analyses, and share results as dashboards or data apps.

This new third-party sub-processor has been verified to ensure they meet our security and privacy standards and will meet our data processing terms. No customer-owned production data will be provided to this sub-processor.

If you’ve received this update by email, it is because you subscribed to our Trust Center. You can view the full list of Octopus Deploy’s subprocessors here: [https://trust.octopus.com/subprocessors](https://trust.octopus.com/subprocessors) Opens in new tab
